title: 第一卷 人生初见 第七章 圣老求生第一卷 人生初见 第八章 小云雨诀
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
看着丹田内一时间波涛汹涌的真气，长孙心里一紧，真是怕什么来什么，长孙没想到在这个时候体内的真气开始异动，长孙虽然对这种情况早有心理装备，但现在这个时间点还不是长孙心中破关的时刻。
“该死！”长孙在心中暗骂一声，虽然在心里暗恨破关时刻来的如此不合时宜，但此时的情况已不容他迟疑。
长孙全神贯注于体内，死守丹田，想要稳住汹涌的真气，但却无济于事。眼看着丹田内的真气如同起风的海面一般，一股股翻涌的浪花不断冲击丹田，想要冲出丹田，长孙只能在丹田的出口设下最后一道防线，将所有的精神力凝成一堵墙，企图阻挡即将冲出丹田的真气，但丹田内的真气随着时间的推移，没有稳住的趋势，反而变得越来越汹涌。
随着真气的不断冲击，长孙渐渐有些力不从心，凝聚的精神力也有了溃散之势。
长孙知道这样拖下去不是办法，精神力一旦被冲散，四散的真气将会如脱缰的野马一般在自己体内胡乱冲击，到时造成的伤害足以要了自己的小命。想到这长孙额头渗出一层细密的汗珠。
这样不是办法啊，于其坐以待毙，还不如拼死一搏。
长孙深吸几口气，深冬的寒气又干又冷，吸进体内如同一口烈酒，从鼻腔辣到胸腔。
长孙清醒了几分，强迫自己镇定下来，此时正是最关键的时刻，自己稍有不慎就可能再也没机会睁开双眼了。
“冷静下来，冷静下来…”长孙在心里不断的提醒自己，只有冷静下来才能找到活路。
冷静后的长孙开始思考接下来该怎么办，自从知道总有一天破镜之日将会来临，长孙就开始思考怎样能压制住自己的境界，同时也开始大量的搜索有关的书籍，希望能找到一条前人走过的保险之路。但长孙翻阅多日，却并未寻见这样的记载。
确实，此时长孙这样的行为在外人看来着实是愚昧之极，即使有人放慢破镜的进程，企图筑基完全，也很少有人会如长孙这般企图将即将离弦的箭收回来。
就在长孙即将绝望的时候，他忽然想起曾经看过的一本野史杂记，名为《圣老游记》，这本杂记记载了近三百年来的一位传奇人物，圣老。
大陆经历了末世之战、百老会之乱后，大陆的强者快速凋零。由于百老会对尊者的束缚，不仅使大陆长期处于无尊者的空白期，就连凡者镜的强者，为了避免破境称尊后被百老会束缚，都选择了隐于凡世。
因此圣者便成了大陆的至强者。
而圣老则可以称的上是圣者中的“尊者”，被人们称为五百年来的大陆第一圣者。
说起圣老，也是大陆的一段传奇，圣老原名是什么已经没有人记得了，只知道在他成圣之前，被人们叫做沈老。
虽然大陆支离破碎，但依旧孕育着一代一代优秀的人才，每一代年轻武者就仿佛怒放的鲜花，在这片即使残缺了但依旧肥沃的大陆上越长越密，越开越旺。
在这百花丛中，当时年轻的沈老甚至连朵野花都算不上，在同辈中人都已在大陆初露头角时，沈老却在修炼的道路中屡受挫折，在他的一本自传中就曾记载他在年轻时，想要进入大陆第一的武者学府，帝都府，却因天赋极差而未能顺利考入，最后几经波折只能成为了帝都府藏经阁的一位书童，说是进入了帝都府，其实只是一名下人，不过这就足以让当时的沈老满足了。
沈老之后的百年便都在这帝都府的藏经阁度过，百年时光，帝都府送走一茬又一茬的学子，一张张熟悉的面孔走出这所学府，又有一张张新面孔满怀期待的走进来，不变的是这座历史悠久的藏经阁，和阁内几乎被人遗忘的书童。
青涩的容颜逝去，挺拔的身姿也变得佝偻。

直到一场关乎帝都府生死的战争，才让人们重新认识“沈老”这个名字。
当时大陆诸雄围攻帝都府，帝都府即将沦陷，各路豪强聚集藏经阁，这座历史悠久，气势磅礴的藏经阁深深的刺激了现场的掠夺者。
利益熏心的人们并未发现在藏经阁正前还有一位老人，旁若无人的扫地，这一幅极静的画面与外面的混乱格格不入，却又那么的自然，让人们情不自禁的驻足。
不知是谁，不合时宜的大叫了一嗓子，才将沉静在平静当中的众人喊醒，人们这才恍然醒悟，此时的藏经阁就是一座任人掠夺的金山银山。
于是众人都红了眼的往藏经阁冲，此时人们才发现藏经阁前还有一位老人。
被利益冲昏头脑的众人想都没想就举起屠刀，打算将这拦路的绊脚石斩于脚下。
就在这时，让人意想不到的事情发生了。
一把竹扫帚，一个弱不禁风的老者，却仿佛一道天堑横在藏经阁前。
三天后，帝都府爆出让大陆所有人震惊的消息，帝都府藏经阁前一名扫地老者，一人之力独战诸雄，各路豪强损伤惨重，圣者伤亡殆尽，溃不成军，退出帝都府，帝都府因一人之力保住一线生机。
这名老者便是沈老，沈老一战成名，之后更是以其变化莫测的法术和其深厚的内力在大陆强势崛起，之后更是被人们称为大陆第一圣者，从此被人们尊称其为“圣老”。
《圣老游记》这本书，记载的是在距离帝都府之战百年后，圣老游历大陆的见闻。
据说，在圣老十八岁进入帝都府后便再未踏出过帝都府，直到圣老他二百岁时，才再次走出帝都府，一人一车游历大陆，追寻世间长生大道。
这本《圣老游记》是圣老当时游历大陆的车夫所著，而圣老也在那次游历之后在大陆消失，再也无人知晓他的踪迹，不知其生死，因此这本书的真实性也无从考证。
这本书记载的大多是车夫与圣老一路的所见所闻，并无过多修炼的信息，故并不受武者们欢迎。
此时想起这本书，是因为书中曾有这样的记载：圣老一日夜间酣饮，泛着醉意与车夫提起初入修炼之道时的事，圣老天生资质平庸，而丹田的狭小更是限制了圣老在修炼一路上的发展，苦恼的圣老苦思冥想，最终想到日常用的麻绳，若不一股一股的编织在一起，便是一团乱麻，但若一股一股编织成麻绳，不仅会节省很多空间，还会更加结实，那真气若也如麻绳一般编织在一起岂不是既节省了丹田的空间，又使真气更加凝练，这不就解决了他丹田狭小的问题了么，正是因为他的这一奇思妙想才成就了他之后内力深厚，真气凝练刁钻的威名。
虽然书中并未对圣老如何做成这真气的麻绳，但却无疑是给长孙开了一扇窗，让长孙见识到修炼一途也并非一定要循规蹈矩。
之后长孙尝试过圣老所说的方法，却发现并非说的这么简单，即使以长孙两世灵魂而凝聚的庞大精神力，也难以支撑长孙完成这一想法。长孙难以想象当时的圣老是有多么磅礴的精神力。
失败的尝试并没有使长孙放弃，长孙渐渐有了新的想法，但却一直没敢尝试，因为新的想法只是想想就让长孙感到很危险，若失败很可能就是万劫不复。
此时的情况已经让长孙没有选择，只能放手一搏，长孙尽量使自己平静下来，在心中再次回想自己设想的这一方法的各个细节。
确实有可行性，长孙不再犹豫开始付诸行动。

长孙从丹田开口凝集的那堵“墙”上，迅速的游离出一股精神力，进入丹田内。
此时的丹田内的真气已经仿佛沸腾的开水一般，长孙便是要搅动一壶沸腾的开水，使其形成一个巨大的漩涡。
content_en:
Seeing the turbulent zhenqi in his dantian, Changsun's heart tightened. He was really afraid of what might happen. Changsun didn't expect that the zhenqi in his body would start to change at this time. Although Changsun had already been mentally prepared for this situation, this time was not the moment for Changsun to break through.
"Damn it!" Changsun cursed in his heart. Although he secretly resented that the moment of breaking the barrier came at such an untimely time, the situation at this time no longer allowed him to hesitate.
Changsun concentrated on his body and guarded his Dantian, trying to stabilize the surging Qi, but to no avail. Seeing that the true energy in the Dantian was like a windy sea, with surging waves constantly hitting the Dantian and trying to break out of the Dantian, Changsun could only set up a last line of defense at the exit of the Dantian, condensing all his mental power into a wall in an attempt to block the true energy that was about to rush out of the Dantian. However, as time went by, the true energy in the Dantian did not stabilize and instead became more and more turbulent.
With the continuous impact of the true energy, Changsun gradually became unable to do what he wanted, and the concentrated mental power also began to collapse.
Changsun knew that procrastinating like this was not an option. Once his mental power was dissipated, the scattered energy would rush wildly through his body like a wild horse, and the damage caused would be enough to kill him. Thinking of this eldest grandson, a thin layer of sweat formed on his forehead.
This is not the solution. Instead of just sitting there and waiting for death, it is better to fight to the death.
Changsun took a few deep breaths. The cold air of late winter was dry and cold. It was like a mouthful of strong wine, burning from his nose to his chest.
Changsun woke up a little and forced himself to calm down. This was the most critical moment. If he was not careful, he might never have the chance to open his eyes again.
"Calm down, calm down..." Changsun kept reminding himself in his heart that only by calming down could he find a way to survive.
After calming down, the eldest grandson began to think about what to do next. Ever since he knew that one day the mirror would be broken, the eldest grandson began to think about how to suppress his own state. At the same time, he also began to search a lot of relevant books, hoping to find a safe path that his predecessors had taken. But Changsun read through it for many days, but found no such record.
Indeed, Changsun's behavior at this time is really extremely foolish to outsiders. Even if someone slows down the process of breaking the mirror and attempts to build a complete foundation, few people will try to take back the arrow that is about to leave the string like Changsun.
Just when the grandson was about to despair, he suddenly remembered a miscellany he had read called "The Travels of the Holy Lao". This miscellany recorded a legendary figure in the past three hundred years, the Holy Lao.
After the mainland experienced the Apocalypse War and the Bai Laohui Rebellion, the mainland's strong men quickly withered. Due to the restraint of the Elders by the Elders, not only has the continent been in a long-term void without honors, but even the powerful people in the Mortal Mirror have chosen to hide in the mortal world in order to avoid being restrained by the Elders after breaking through the realm and claiming honor.
Therefore, the saint became the most powerful person in the continent.
The Holy Elder can be called the "Venerable" among saints, and is known as the first saint in the mainland in the past five hundred years.
Speaking of the Holy Elder, it is also a legend in mainland China. No one remembers the original name of the Holy Elder. They only know that before he became a saint, he was called Elder Shen.
Although the continent is fragmented, it still nurtures generations of outstanding talents. Each generation of young warriors is like a blooming flower, growing denser and blooming more prosperously on this fragmented but still fertile continent.
Among these flowers, the young Mr. Shen at that time was not even a wild flower. When many of his peers were beginning to make their mark on the mainland, Mr. Shen suffered repeated setbacks on the road of cultivation. He once recorded this in his autobiography. When he was young, he wanted to enter the mainland's number one martial arts academy, the Imperial Capital Palace, but was unable to pass the exam due to his extremely poor talent. In the end, after many twists and turns, he could only become a book boy in the Imperial Capital Palace's Sutra Collection Pavilion. It was said that he entered the Imperial Capital Palace.In fact, he was just a servant, but this was enough to satisfy Mr. Shen at that time.
Mr. Shen spent the next hundred years in the Sutra Collection Pavilion of the Imperial Capital Mansion. Over the past hundred years, the Imperial Capital Mansion sent away students one after another. Familiar faces walked out of this school, and new faces walked in with expectations. What remained unchanged was this historic Scripture Collection Pavilion and the almost forgotten book boy in the pavilion.
The youthful appearance has gone, and the tall and straight figure has become rickety.
It wasn't until a war related to the life and death of the Imperial Capital that people recognized the name "Mr. Shen" again.
At that time, the heroes from the mainland were besieging the Imperial Capital Palace. The Imperial Capital Palace was about to fall. Powerful people from all walks of life gathered in the Sutra Library Pavilion. This historic and majestic Sutra Library Pavilion deeply stimulated the looters at the scene.
People who were motivated by interests did not notice that there was an old man in front of the Sutra Pavilion, sweeping the floor as if no one was around. This extremely quiet picture was incompatible with the chaos outside, but it was so natural that people couldn't help but stop.
I don't know who it was, but shouted at an inappropriate time, waking everyone up from the silence. Then people suddenly realized that the Sutra Pavilion at this time was a mountain of gold and silver that could be plundered.
So everyone rushed to the Sutra Pavilion with red eyes. At this time, people discovered that there was an old man in front of the Sutra Pavilion.
Everyone who was dazzled by the benefits raised their butcher's knives without thinking, intending to cut this stumbling block under their feet.
At this moment, something unexpected happened.
A bamboo broom and a frail old man seemed to be a natural chasm in front of the Sutra Pavilion.
Three days later, news broke out in the Imperial Palace that shocked everyone in the mainland. An old man sweeping the floor in front of the Sutra-Tibetan Pavilion of the Imperial Palace fought against all the heroes by himself. The heroes of all walks of life suffered heavy losses. The saints suffered heavy casualties and were defeated. They withdrew from the Imperial Palace. The Imperial Palace managed to save a slim chance of survival due to the power of one person.
This old man is Mr. Shen. Mr. Shen became famous in the first battle. Later, he rose to power in the mainland with his unpredictable magic and deep internal power. Later, he was called the number one saint in the mainland. From then on, he was respected as the "Holy Old Man".
The book "The Travels of the Holy Lao" records what the Holy Lao traveled to the mainland a hundred years after the battle of the Imperial Capital.
It is said that after the Holy Lao entered the Imperial Capital Mansion at the age of eighteen, he never left the Imperial Capital Mansion again. It was not until the Holy Lao was 200 years old that he left the Imperial Capital Mansion again and traveled around the mainland, one person and one car, in pursuit of the road to immortality in the world.
This book "The Travels of the Holy Lao" was written by the coachman who traveled to the mainland at that time. The Holy Lao also disappeared on the mainland after that trip. No one knows his traces, life or death, so the authenticity of this book cannot be verified.
This book records mostly what the coachman and the sage saw and heard along the way, without much information on cultivation, so it is not popular among warriors.
I thought of this book at this time because there was such a record in the book: The sage drank heavily one night and was drunk and mentioned to the coachman what happened when he first entered the path of cultivation. The sage was born with mediocre qualifications, and the narrowness of the Dantian restricted the development of the sage along the way of cultivation. The distressed sage thought hard and finally thought of the hemp rope used in daily life. If it is not woven together one by one, it will be a ball. It is messy, but if the strands are woven into a hemp rope, it will not only save a lot of space, but also become stronger. Then if the true energy is woven together like a hemp rope, wouldn't it not only save the space in the Dantian, but also make the true energy more condensed?
Although the book does not explain how the sage made this true energy hemp rope, it undoubtedly opened a window for the eldest grandson to see that cultivation does not necessarily require following rules.
Later, Changsun tried the method mentioned by the sage, but found that it was not as simple as it was said.The huge mental power condensed from his soul cannot support Changsun to complete this idea. Changsun could not imagine how powerful the holy elder was at that time.
The failed attempt did not make Changsun give up. Changsun gradually came up with new ideas, but he never dared to try them because just thinking about the new ideas made Changsun feel very dangerous. If he failed, he would probably be doomed.
The situation at this time left Changsun with no choice but to give it a try. Changsun tried his best to calm himself down and recalled every detail of the method he had conceived.
It was indeed feasible, and Changsun no longer hesitated and started taking action.
Changsun quickly released a stream of spiritual power from the "wall" condensed at the opening of his dantian and entered his dantian.
At this time, the zhenqi in Dantian was already like boiling water. Changsun wanted to stir a pot of boiling water to make it form a huge vortex.
